senses.definition: To microphone; to place one or more microphones (mikes) on.
examples:

senses.definition: (international standards) Alternative letter-case form of Mike from the NATO/ICAO Phonetic Alphabet.

examples: We'll be there in one zero mikes [i.e. ten minutes].

quotes.text: The beginner's dose may be anywhere from 100 to 250 mikes — micrograms, or millionths of a gram. Most hardened heads need 600 to 800 mikes, and some as many as 1,400 mikes, before they experience any sensation of getting off.
